title: Study: Antibiotics Can Cause Harm to Flu Patients
snippet: Antibiotics are often prescribed for patients experiencing a respiratory illness. But when tests reveal that a virus—such as influenza—is causing the illness, antibiotics should be stopped, Cedars-Sinai investigators say.
